description: A C# game engine in which a program opens a window, draws each frame with plain static calls named as raylib's functions are, and draws Dear ImGui in the same frame, over SDL3, Vulkan and Slang, with an ECS and source-generated behaviors underneath.
releaseNotes:
A mesh entity draws a mesh the program uploaded or indexed arrays, keeps its mesh while it lives whether drawn or not, and keeps every look past four thousand, a freed mesh letting go of its own looks alone.
A component that names its key through IKeyed has its entities found by it through an index the world keeps as each is added, replaced, removed or despawned, a lookup allocating nothing.
A behavior holds a reference to what nothing can change, a record or sealed class of readonly fields of such values, with no warning, so a stack keeps its item where it kept the item's id.
A query takes up to six components, by copy, by reference and read only, each walking the store with the fewest and filtered as the smaller queries are.
A game's test builds an app with no window through the public AddPlugin and steps its behaviors a frame a call with Frame, and disposing an app shuts it down as CloseWindow does.
A material's ShadowOnly draws its mesh into the shadow maps alone, so a game that leaves the rock over a cave out of its view keeps the sun off the cave's floor, saved with the readings of the grove's glow lights by the way each pixel took, the grove on 5.2.215 and on HEAD, and the cave with the game's culling on and off.
The glow lights carry the box their reach lies in, so a point past it takes none of their light without being weighed against each, which takes the voxel game's cherry grove at 1920 by 1080 at High from 9.1 ms of scene pass to 8.4 on the development machine's GPU.
The model pass takes the share of the sky its probes see in the same gather as their light, which takes the voxel game's cherry grove at 1920 by 1080 at High from 10.1 ms of scene pass to 8.9 on the development machine's GPU.
title: 3DEngine
